post.caption:
Orbit is about sideways speed, not height: roughly 28,000 km/h. And the fuel to reach it has weight, so you need fuel to lift the fuel, which compounds rather than adds. That is the tyranny of the rocket equation, and it is why a launch vehicle is almost entirely tank with a sliver of payload on top. Staging is the workaround: drop the empty mass mid-flight so everything above it becomes easier to push. Space is expensive because of arithmetic.
